facts.business: Blue Dart Express Limited operates in the express air and integrated transportation and distribution industry.
facts.related_party_note: All contracts have been executed on Arm's length basis on competitive terms. Details of material contracts or arrangement or transactions at arm's length basis include Term Loan Agreement, DG Training Services, Freight Forward and Handling & Clearing Services Agreement, MRO Services, Cargo Movement Services Agreement, Dangerous Goods (DG) Training Services and General Aviation Security (AVSEC) Training Services, Freight Forwarding Services, Annual Boeing fees for data Hosting & Technical support services with related parties such as Blue Dart Express Limited (Holding Company), Air Works India (Engineering) Private Limited, DHL Express (India) Private Limited, DHL Logistics Private Limited, DHL Aviation (Netherlands) B.V.
